transcript: Google just open-sourced an AI model that can predict literally anything in the future. Plus, it'll also give you a full range from best-case to worst-case scenario, so you know how confident you should be. And it takes into account external factors like holidays, weather, and prices at the same time. Now to use it, you can either install it yourself using a coding agent or access it right inside of Google Sheets and BigQuery. Want to try it for yourselves?
